note: Only facts printed on the seller's own official pages are recorded. Empty values mean 'not verified', never 'no'.

sellers.name: Blue Nile
sellers.type: Large online retailer (now also operates the James Allen collection)
sellers.return_window: 30 days from shipment, original unworn condition; 2 free returns per customer per year
sellers.return_exclusions: Personalised jewellery, custom orders, engraved items, items resized after initial purchase, Diamond Upgrade Program purchases, clearance and Final Sale items
sellers.resize_policy: One free resize up or down two sizes within 6 months if the design permits; eternity bands and some ornate bands cannot be resized
sellers.payment_notes: Page refers to card credit and to bank-wire refunds, i.e. bank wire is an accepted payment method — an irreversible method under your checklist
sellers.price_display: Setting price shown separately from centre-stone price
sellers.verification: Return policy, phone and email verified on the official return-policy page on 2026-10-22.

sellers.name: Mejuri
sellers.return_window: 30 days from delivery or in-store pickup (US, Canada, UK, Australia, Germany); free return shipping in those countries
sellers.return_exclusions: Engraved and monogrammed products, final sale items (including 'Before We Melt'), gift cards, earrings used during a piercing appointment; items must be unworn with all original packaging; set items must be returned complete
sellers.resize_policy: Not stated on the pages reviewed
sellers.payment_notes: Klarna instalments offered on product pages (0% interest, 4 payments)
sellers.price_display: Fixed price, or 'From' price that varies by size
sellers.verification: 30-day window and the non-returnable list verified verbatim on the official FAQ page on 2026-10-22. No phone or email was published on the pages reviewed — left blank rather than guessed.

sellers.name: Costco
sellers.return_window: Risk-free 100% satisfaction guarantee on merchandise, with listed exceptions
sellers.return_exclusions: 'Precious metals are non-refundable.' Diamonds of 1.00 ct or larger require all original IGI/GIA paperwork and are settled with a jewellery credit memo after inspection by Costco's graduate gemologist within 48 hours; custom/special-order items non-returnable
sellers.resize_policy: Product page states rings are sizable within 1 size but 'Costco does not provide this service'
sellers.payment_notes: Membership required to buy; no payment-method detail verified on the pages reviewed
sellers.price_display: Price was not displayed on the item page as fetched
sellers.verification: The exact sentence 'Precious metals are non-refundable.' and the 1.00 ct diamond exception were verified verbatim on Costco's official customer-service page on 2026-10-22. Phone/email not published on the pages reviewed, so left blank.

sellers.name: Wilson's Estate Jewelry
sellers.return_window: Contact within 7 calendar days of delivery; item must be back within 3 calendar days of receiving the return label
sellers.return_exclusions: Sold 'as is'; no refund if contacted late or returned late; items must be unworn, unaltered and in original packaging; cancelled-before-shipment orders are not refunded the 3% credit-card processing fee
sellers.resize_policy: Listings state whether a ring is 'sizable'; resizing is done by the buyer's jeweller
sellers.payment_notes: Card processing fee of 3% is referenced for cancellations, confirming card payment is accepted; instalment plan shown on product pages
sellers.offers_xrf_or_assay: Not offered per item; 'Stamped for X karat' is the seller's statement. Some pieces are described as 'tested as' a karat
sellers.verification: Weight in grams, stamp description, maker's mark, phone and email verified verbatim on three individual official product pages on 2026-10-22. This is the only seller in the study that publishes gram weights.
